summary: Fixed reviewer blockers for T1: POSIX default command resolution now uses an executable lookup command, and Admin agent listing reuses full provider status structures from real DriverRegistry status output while preserving metadata fallback.
notes: listAgents remains synchronous for existing Admin tests and callers; it now prefers providerStatuses and accepts both array and object-map forms before falling back to getProviderMetadata.
Default command resolution keeps execFile and timeouts, uses where on Windows, and uses which on non-Windows instead of the POSIX shell builtin command.
Traceability behavior-level mappings remain complete and unchanged because test/evidence paths did not change.
